test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 04 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Which of the following pairs of state and folk dance is correctly paired?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Punjab – Bhangra dance**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhangra** is a lively folk dance originating from the state of **Punjab **in India.
 
• It is traditionally performed during the harvest festival of **Baisakhi **and other celebrations.
 
• Bhangra involves energetic movements and is usually performed to the** beat of the dhol, a traditional drum**.
 
• It has gained popularity worldwide and is often performed at cultural events and competitions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gujarat** is known for its **Garba and Dandiya Raas** dances.
 
• **Haryana** is known for its **Saang and Phag **dances.
 
• **Kerala** is famous for its** Kathakali and Mohiniyattam** dances.
 
• **Bihu dance** is associated with the state of **Assam**.
 
• **Ghoomar dance** is associated with the state of **Rajasthan**.
